_note: The delivery manifest. sync.py reads this and checks out only the paths whose unlock moment has passed. Unlock times carry an explicit -07:00 offset on purpose: the dev container's clock is UTC, and a bare date would open a week on Monday evening local time. Dates come from scripts/build_calendar.py (Spring 2027). A session is keyed by its MODULE slug, never a week number -- the slug is also the branch, the tag and the scorecard selector. A session is DUE the Wednesday 11:59 PM after its Thursday session and is locked then -- no late credit.
